stem.text: The diagram shows a laboratory experiment in which a feather falls from rest in a long evacuated vertical tube of length $L$.

stem.alt: Vertical evacuated tube with a feather near its top. A vertical arrow beside the tube is labelled L. Labels: feather, vacuum.

stem.text: The feather takes time $T$ to fall from the top to the bottom of the tube.
How far does the feather fall from the top of the tube in time $0.50T$?
